name: make-it-zen
description: Zen-inspired features for Firefox: copy tab URL shortcut with toast, and Glance link previews.

scripts.lint: web-ext lint --source-dir . --ignore-files node_modules dist tests dev-notes screenshots .claude
scripts.build: web-ext build --source-dir . --artifacts-dir dist --overwrite-dest --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json node_modules dist README.md DEBUGGING.md CLAUDE.md tests screenshots dev-notes .gitignore .git .github .claude
